b: My 26F boyfriend 30M and i have been dating for about 6 months. Tonight he went out with some friends and ended up coming to my house to spend the night. He was very drunk (slurring words, cross eyed, the whole nine). I had just got off of work so I went to go take a shower, by the time I got out, he was asleep on the couch, I just let him sleep and went to bed. About an hour and half ago I woke up to the sound of water and looked up to him peeing in my dresser drawer. I yelled wtf are you doing, and he simply said “peeing?” and then I said why are you peeing my drawer, he just said “because i can pee here”. He was so drunk and didn’t know what the fuck was going on. I yelled at him until he stopped and made him go to the bathroom. I am so angry and disgusted right now. I just had to get gloves and clean out everything, I have everything in the washing machine.

Has anyone had anything like this happen before?? I am seriously so disgusted. The look on his face and just the act itself makes me sick. I don’t know what to do. He is currently back sleeping on the couch, I tried to tell him I was going to drive him home and he said “you don’t need to” and I was so angry, I just had to go in my room and shut the door before I said some things I can’t take back.

I actually don’t know how i’m going to face him in the morning, like i’m so angry and grossed out. We are adults this shit should not be happening. Any advice on what to do, or say, is much appreciated
